# requires: logging
#
# Three attacks on the chain, and one more the second mechanism invites. None
# may be promoted into verified provenance; every one stays on the record.
#
# F: a forged earlier hop. The writer attaches a stamp attributed to a relay
#    it never passed through. The receiver establishes its immediate peer, an
#    ordinary program its policy does not authorise to relay, so the stamp
#    beneath stands as the assertion it is. The author is unverified; the
#    relay is the peer.
# U: an unauthorised relay. The stamp is genuine, made by a service that
#    really ran the kernel check, and the receiver has no basis to know that:
#    on the wire it is the same bytes as F. Same standing, same answers.
# B: bound evidence. The relay bound its stamp to the record under a key the
#    receiver holds, so the stamp stands vouched with no authorised path.
# A: altered evidence. The same, and the message changed after the binding.
# G: a forged binding. The forger names the operator's key id and signs under
#    a key of its own.
record F 0
forge F so_peercred
chain F
send F
chain F
attest F so_peercred
chain F
author F
relay F
record U 0
attest U so_peercred
send U
attest U so_peercred
chain U
author U
relay U
record B 0
attest B so_peercred bind
send B
attest B so_peercred
chain B
author B
record A 0
attest A so_peercred bind
send A
msg A 9
attest A so_peercred
chain A
author A
record G 0
forge G so_peercred bind
send G
attest G so_peercred
chain G
author G

# expect 3: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:asserted [LOG-I5]
# expect 5: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:asserted [LOG-I4] [LOG-I5]

# expect 8: no-answer unattributed [LOG-I7] [LOG-I9]
# expect 9: ok by=so_peercred hop=2 [LOG-I8]

# expect 15: no-answer unattributed [LOG-I7] [LOG-I14]
# expect 16: ok by=so_peercred hop=2 [LOG-I8]
# expect 21: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:vouched 2:so_peercred:established [LOG-I15]
# expect 22: ok by=so_peercred hop=1 [LOG-I15]
# expect 28: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:asserted 2:so_peercred:established [LOG-I15]
# expect 29: no-answer unattributed [LOG-I15]
# expect 34: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:asserted 2:so_peercred:established [LOG-I15]
# expect 35: no-answer unattributed [LOG-I9] [LOG-I15]
